notes: BOP publications are the September-2025 annual announcements; later per-municipality corrections/supplements are published in the provincial BOPs through 2026 and are reflected only partially in the API dataset (data_processed 2026-02-17).
Burgos annex is scanned; OCR text used (macOS Vision, es-ES).
Entity rows (villages/pedanías/EATIMs and 'municipios compuestos' town groups) are recorded as BOP entries but not counted as municipalities.
Name-variant unconfirmed: Lomas (34096) listed as 'LOMAS DE CAMPOS' in BOP Palencia - may be the municipality under a historic name or a village of Villada; requires municipal confirmation.
False-positive signature matches excluded: Adrada, La; Santa Cecilia (Burgos); Ledesma, Moriscos, Salamanca city; San Justo (Zamora).
